current_reporting_regime.public_period_rule: Only the third month of each fund's fiscal quarter is intended to be public; first and second month reports are not public.
current_reporting_regime.filing_deadline: 60 days after the end of the fund's fiscal quarter
current_reporting_regime.complete_calendar_quarter_picture: approximately four months after quarter end, due to reporting and different fund fiscal calendars
current_reporting_regime.2026_proposal_summary: Would extend filing to 45 days after month end, retain public reporting only for the third month of a fiscal quarter with 60-day public delay, and remove the non-derivative payoff-profile item; do not implement proposed fields or cadence as current law.

included: ETFs organized as unit investment trusts
registered mutual funds other than money market funds
separate accounts offering variable annuity contracts
excluded_or_not_covered: private hedge funds that do not file Form N-PORT
all institutional investors outside the Form N-PORT filer population

short_position_semantics.short_value_sign_crosscheck: SEC's 2026 proposal states funds generally report positive values for long non-derivative positions and negative values for short non-derivative positions.
short_position_semantics.discordant_profile_value_rows: QUARANTINE_AND_AUDIT; do not silently choose one field
short_position_semantics.first_hypothesis_scope: non-derivative equity-common, corporate issuer, US investment country, PAYOFF_PROFILE=short, and negative CURRENCY_VALUE; require a PIT security crosswalk before claiming US-listed common equity

sec_december_2024_consistency_statistic.interpretation: classification/value-sign inconsistency rates, not the prevalence of short positions

pit.acceptance_timestamp_source: SEC-HEADER acceptance timestamp and/or SEC submissions metadata keyed by accession
pit.conservative_knowledge_rule: Use the first verified public filing/receipt timestamp; until an immutable first-receipt capture exists, use the SEC acceptance timestamp and execute no earlier than the next full regular trading session. If using a quarterly bulk archive as the data source, use the archive's own publication/receipt time instead.
pit.amendment_rule: Append every NPORT-P/A as a new version and apply it only from its own verified availability time; never overwrite or backdate the prior filing.

candidate_hypotheses: Change in aggregate direct non-derivative US common-equity short market value across reporting fund series
Breadth of reporting fund series opening or increasing shorts versus reducing or covering them
Short exposure normalized by fund NAV and issuer market capitalization
Persistence and concentration of short exposure, with controls for prior returns, liquidity, volatility and options flow
decision: Retain N-PORT direct short exposure as a distinct conditional public-data hypothesis, not as short interest or proof of informed trading. The next gate is a deterministic sample audit of actual non-derivative US common-equity short rows, amendment/acceptance vintages, fund-series deduplication, and PIT security coverage. Do not run returns or promote a feature until these gates pass.
